Sandbox_MinidoracatBagsLockLegacyBags: Lock old Bag Upgrade Plus bags
Sandbox_MinidoracatBagsLockLegacyBags_to:
When on (default), old bags from Bag Upgrade Plus saves only let you take items out. Nothing can be put in. Players turn them into new bags with a sewing recipe.
Turn off to use them as normal bags again.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBagsMaxTier_tooltip:
Highest tier a bag can reach with the Reinforce Bag recipes. 0 turns upgrading off.
Converted old bags start at this tier.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBagsCapacityStepPerce:
Each tier adds this percentage of the bag's original capacity, rounded to the nearest whole number. Capacity never goes above 50 minus the bag's own weight.
Applies to bags upgraded after the change.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBagsWeightReductionSt:
Each tier adds this much Encumbrance Reduction, up to the maximum Encumbrance Reduction below.
Applies to bags upgraded after the change.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBagsMaxWeightReductio: Upgraded and converted bags never go above this Encumbrance Reduction.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBagsLootMultiplier_to:
Scales how often the new bags appear in police, military and medical containers, and how often police, soldier and medic zombies drop one. 0 turns both off.
Container loot reads this value when the world loads.
